An '''unremarkable planet''' located far from inhabited [[Planet/Legends|worlds]]. The outskirts of the planet were rarely visited by [[Starship/Legends|starships]], so anyone who found themselves on its surface without a way to leave was doomed to a lonely [[Death/Legends|death]] from depleted supplies or the dangerous wildlife.

==History==
===Deadly trap===
{{Quote|BZZTI FZZZTI... Day one hundred twenty -- I think.>BZZT<... I have to do what needs to be done while I still have the strength. My blaster's almost out of power. I'm sure not going to let it take me like it took the others. If you're watching this holo, well, thanks for nothing.|The final entry of a shipwreck survivor|<ref name="E22" />}}
[[File:Falconamongfungtree.jpg|left|thumb|350px|The [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] flies over the surface of the planet]]
A small planet, lost in a desolate corner of [[Realspace/Legends|space]], appeared from orbit as a somber purple sphere devoid of any distinct features. Yet its pale exterior concealed a world where natural conditions met the basic requirements for the existence of [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]] such as [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]]. On the mist-shrouded surface at the foot of the [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] grew ordinary-looking [[Tree/Legends|trees]] interspersed with shrubs, as well as forests of tall, slender-stemmed organisms topped with purple caps, outwardly resembling [[Fungus/Legends|fungi]]. Nevertheless, the planet lay far from inhabited [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] and seemed so insignificant that it had not even been given the simplest of names.<ref name="E22" />

At some point, a [[Corellia/Legends|Corellian]] [[Consular-class light cruiser/Legends|''Consular''-class cruiser]] crashed onto the planet's surface. The crew was unable to repair the damage on their own, and without rescue their fate seemed sealed. The survivors began broadcasting a continuous distress signal into the surrounding cosmic space, hoping someone would detect it. However, the crash attracted a [[Carnivorous creeping creature|native carnivorous creature]] resembling a tangled mass of plant-like tendrils. The predator besieged the wrecked vessel, periodically killing those who remained alive inside. Nearly half a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] passed before the last surviving crew member, exhausted and despairing, took his own life after the ship's supplies were completely depleted. Even then, the cruiser's remaining power sustained a faint distress signal that continued to echo into the void, unnoticed for decades after the disaster.<ref name="E22" />

===Investigation of the crash===
{{Quote|Ugh. Can you imagine being stranded here?''"<br />"''That's why we have to help, Han.|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] are investigating the source of the distress signal.|<ref name="E22" />}}
[[File:ConsularCrash.jpg|thumb|right|350px|Chewbacca and Han Solo find the source of the distress signal]]
Several [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] emerged from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] near a planet, having made a jump to a random location that was unremarkable enough to avoid [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] pursuit. While trying to contact other [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] ships, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], and [[Deena Shan]] received a distress signal from the surface of a grim planet. Despite fears that the signal might be an Imperial trap, the Falcon's crew decided to investigate.<ref name="E22" />

After landing, Solo and Chewbacca set out to locate the source of the signal, insisting that Organa and Shan remain safely aboard. Pushing through dense undergrowth, they stumbled upon an old Corellian cruiser – the very ship that had been sending the distress signal. Inside the rusted wreck, no one had been alive for years, and the only clues to what had happened were the [[Hologram/Legends|holograms]] left by one of the crew members. As they watched, the remaining energy finally died out, taking the distress signal with it. Just as Solo and Chewbacca were about to return to the Falcon, a predatory lurker – patiently waiting for years for new prey – attacked from the shadows. Organa and Shan heard the sounds of [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire and rushed to help. Together, the four of them overcame to kill the creature and return safely to the Millennium Falcon.<ref name="E22" />
